figures.label: Time Required
figures.source: Three things deserve priority in these first 90 days: converting your NRE/NRO accounts once your residency status is clear, closing out any interview loops you started while still abroad instead of letting them go cold, and giving yourself a real adjustment period before judging whether the return was the right call.
